environment.description: Same Terraform provider deployed via Terraform Cloud managed agent pool. The workspace has LAUNCHDARKLY_SDK_KEY configured as a sensitive environment variable pointing to the production LD project. The flag 'use-safe-extractor' is configured with a targeting rule: default variation is TRUE for all contexts where the 'terraform-provider' user key matches (which is hardcoded in evaluateFlag). The flag has a prerequisite on 'kill-switch-legacy-paths' which is also ON. The flag's fallthrough variation is TRUE and the off-variation is also TRUE (belt-and-suspenders configuration set by platform team). The LD project has a relay proxy sidecar in the agent pool VPC ensuring sub-100ms flag evaluation even if edge CDN is degraded. Flag variation history shows it has been TRUE continuously for 14 months with no scheduled changes.

config.runtime: Terraform Cloud managed agent, Linux container, non-root
config.network: Relay proxy sidecar at 127.0.0.1:8030, LD streaming endpoint reachable
config.filesystem: Container runs with read-only root filesystem except /tmp/terraform-workdir, seccomp profile blocks symlink creation
